title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Statement Computation Note — The Minimum-Satisfying Payment
content:
**Clause.** On a Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account, the minimum-satisfying payment is the latest statement's printed minimum payment due plus that statement's past-due amount, less the payments credited since the statement date, never below zero, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Entries posted since the statement date

Entries posted since the statement date are the ledger entries carrying the statement period of the newest ledger entry, when that period is later than the latest statement's period. When the newest ledger entry carries the latest statement's own period, no entry counts as posted since the statement date.

## Inputs

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| Printed minimum payment due | The latest statement |
| Past-due amount | The latest statement |
| Payments credited since the statement date | The payment lines carrying the statement period of the newest ledger entry, when that period is later than the latest statement's period |

## Worked examples (hypothetical, latest statement for the April period)

| Printed minimum | Past-due amount | Newest ledger entry's period | Payments in that period | Minimum-satisfying payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 186.40 | 0.00 | May | 0.00 | 186.40 |
| 186.40 | 120.00 | May | 50.00 | 256.40 |
| 186.40 | 120.00 | May | 400.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) |
| 186.40 | 0.00 | April | none counted | 186.40 |
